entries.title: BF16 TransDataTo5HD Vertical SIMD Accumulate + Native FP16 + Single-TBuf Ping-Pong
entries.bottleneck: Reproducing numpy's non-associative sequential bf16 accumulation forced serial per-row loops while per-row ReduceSum (~240 cyc) and 9 DMA/V syncs stalled tiles.
mechanisms: Transpose 16 rows in UB via TransDataTo5HD so vertical SIMD Add executes exact sequential bf16 rounding across 16 rows simultaneously (~9x speedup)
Pack multiple rows into batched ReduceSumMultiN to amortize ~240-cycle reduction startup
Native FP16 compute path + fused b1/b2 parameter broadcast
Single-TBuf arena with double-buffered MTE2/PIPE_V/MTE3 ping-pong
entries.precision_guard: Bit-identical to sequential numpy bf16 saturation (2080 == 2080 on (5, 4097)); 75/75 extended cases 3-run SHA-256 deterministic.
entries.transferable_rule: When a golden reference requires non-associative sequential rounding along a reduction axis, transpose 16 independent rows via TransDataTo5HD and step vertically with SIMD vector instructions.

entries.title: Two-Half-Ring Async MTE3 + 64-Lane Window-Sliced Gather DP + Double-Buffered log_probs
entries.bottleneck: Every DP step computed the full padded state width [0, saf), rewrote Gather offset tables via Adds, and stalled on synchronous VM3/M3V barriers to flush each log_alpha[t] row.
mechanisms: Slice Gather/Max/Exp/Ln/Select to the active 64-lane band [cStart, cEnd) and fuse boundary masks via And into a single Select per step
Per-slot 32B -inf guard + scalar Gather srcBaseOffset eliminate per-step Adds(offBC/offP) rewrites
Two-half-ring (2*H slots) UB layout drains completed DP rows on MTE3 asynchronously while PIPE_V computes the opposite half-ring
Double-buffered multi-row log_probs MTE2 prefetch + external TPipe for register-promoted loop scalars
entries.precision_guard: Preserves hardware vmax(-inf, -inf) -> 0.0f pairwise order and in-chain PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() across all 8 int32/int64 index combinations.
entries.transferable_rule: In sequential time-step DP kernels, buffer 2*H step outputs in UB so MTE3 bursts H rows asynchronously without blocking PIPE_V, and slice vector width to the reachable state band.

entries.title: NaN-Sentinel Cross-Core Deterministic Reduction + Lean Deduplicated PIPE_V Margin Loop
entries.bottleneck: Multi-core mean/sum reduction via float atomics or unguarded scratch buffers caused non-deterministic drift, TLE hangs, or RE on unaligned is_target tails (C = 9, 13, 16), forcing 1-core execution.
mechanisms: Out-of-domain NaN sentinel (0x7FC00000) + explicit gate-word handshake with DataCacheCleanAndInvalid for zero-workspace cross-core synchronization
Fixed-order fp32 summation on core 0 + single sizeof(T) write to y[0] + deferred is_target prefix restore
Deduplicated target histogram driving tight Adds -> Maxs -> Muls -> Add PIPE_V loop with one final Select + ReduceSum
entries.precision_guard: 100% bit-identical across 2,860 stress launches (including 1,800 launches on C = 9, 13, 16 race shapes).
entries.transferable_rule: Replace non-deterministic cross-core float atomics on scalar outputs with cache-coherent GM slots guarded by an out-of-domain sentinel (NaN 0x7FC00000) + DataCacheCleanAndInvalid, summed in fixed core order on block 0.

entries.title: Canonical Dimension Collapsing + V3 Multi-Regime Separable H/W Vectorized Folding
entries.bottleneck: Enumerating R-dimensional folding preimages per row folded inner W margins repeatedly for every outer preimage combination and issued fragmented per-row DataCopyPad GM reads.
mechanisms: Canonical dimension collapsing drops unit dims and fuses adjacent zero-pad dims so 4D/5D NCHW/NCDHW tensors reduce to 1D/2D/3D with zero copy
Separable Kronecker folding accumulates outer and H margins in UB first so inner W Gather<float> folding runs only once per output row
4 specialized execution regimes: Pure Copy MTE2<->MTE3 stream, Column-Chunked Wide Parallel, Whole-2D-Plane single-DMA batch, and Row-Tiled separable accumulator
Byte-weighted SetBlockDim (~16 KB effective work per AIV core) balances small-shape dispatch vs 40-core saturation
entries.precision_guard: 340/340 extended cases green across reflect/symmetric/circular/edge/constant in fp32 & fp16, with Kahan fallback for negative paddings.
entries.transferable_rule: For separable multi-axis stencil/fold operators, collapse unpadded axes first and reduce outer/row axes in UB before executing inner-axis Gather instructions.

entries.title: 16-Bit Vectorized Widening/Narrowing with Explicit PipeBarrier<PIPE_V> Hazard Ordering
entries.bottleneck: Vectorizing 16-bit boundary accumulation gave 1.43x-1.76x speedups but suffered 10/270 precision failures from mixed-width Cast<half, float> / Cast<float, half> UB hazard overlap.
mechanisms: 64-lane vectorized fp16 -> fp32 Cast widening into row-tile UB accumulators
Explicit PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() ordering narrowing Cast strictly behind widening + Add stages across loop iterations
entries.precision_guard: Eliminated all 10 fp16 precision failures (260/270 -> 270/270 green) while retaining full 1.76x vectorized speedup.
entries.transferable_rule: Insert an explicit PipeBarrier<PIPE_V>() between 16->32-bit widening compute and 32->16-bit narrowing Cast when cycling or overlapping UB buffers on Accel soc-a.
